description_full: Rush Street Interactive, Inc. operates as an online casino and sports betting company in the United States, Canada, and Latin America. The company provides real-money online casinos, online and retail sports betting, and social gaming services. It also offers full suite of games comprising bricks-and-mortar casinos, such as table games, slot machines, and poker games. The company offers its products under BetRivers, PlaySugarHouse, and RushBet brands. Rush Street Interactive, Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

CEO compensation is 1× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity). Governance score flags elevated compensation governance risk (7/10).
financial_summary: Rush Street Interactive, Inc. is a mid-cap consumer cyclical business with a $3.0B market cap on $1.1B of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +24% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +11.1pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.

The business throws off $164M in free cash flow — roughly 14 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 4.95× so those profits are backed by real cash.
Accruals are elevated at -20.0% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 95× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 0.3%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 2.6% of the shares.
